long_biography.plain_text:
Kevin Clark supports older people living at home through fundraising for Meals on Wheels of the Palm Beaches. He has served with Scott Velozo as co-chair of its More Than a Meal luncheon, which Clark and his husband, James Berwind, also sponsored. The charity’s volunteers deliver freshly prepared food and provide companionship and regular wellbeing checks for housebound clients.

Clark and Berwind have also contributed to Palm Beach’s public spaces through a joint gift for park improvements. The donation was designated for a flagpole and a drinking fountain for dogs.
